name: Governor’s House and Pedro Fort, Macau
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary:
A view looking south-west along the Praya Grande, past S. Pedro Fort and the Governor's house towards Penha Hill in the distance. See also E.1750-1928.
On the back are two pencilled figure studies.

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
